graph.name: AWS IoT Architecture for Plato Robot Edge and Cloud Analytics
graph.notes: Architecture for Plato restaurant helper robot by United Robotics Group. On-site local operation is managed by AWS IoT Greengrass running on a dedicated local router without requiring external internet connectivity. Robots hold up to 30 days of data storage offline. When internet is available, telemetry events stream through IoT Core, Kinesis, OpenSearch, and S3.

nodes.name: Plato Robot
nodes.notes: On-site waiter assistant robot carrying up to 30 days of local offline storage.

nodes.name: Remote Devices
nodes.notes: Tablet device used by restaurant staff to command table deliveries.

nodes.name: AWS IoT Greengrass
nodes.notes: Runs locally on a router at the client site to secure local device communications offline.

nodes.name: AWS IoT Core
nodes.notes: Central message broker in AWS VPC for cloud sync and device deployments.

nodes.name: IoT Rule
nodes.notes: Evaluates incoming MQTT topics like event/mission data and routes to Kinesis.

nodes.name: IoT Shadow
nodes.notes: Maintains persistent state representation for devices.

nodes.name: Amazon Kinesis
nodes.notes: Streams real-time event logs and mission telemetry.

nodes.name: Amazon OpenSearch Service
nodes.notes: Provides near real-time operational visualization and monitoring.

nodes.name: Amazon S3
nodes.notes: Stores historical mission data and logs for long-term queries.

nodes.name: AWS Lambda
nodes.notes: Serverless compute function in AWS VPC.

nodes.name: Amazon EKS
nodes.notes: Backend container cluster managing client site definitions and device registration.
